title: Preservation of well-formedness
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n+m$ inputs and let $y$ assign Boolean values to the last $m$ inputs. If every gate of $C$ has distinct input vertices and each NOT gate has exactly one input, then every gate of the circuit obtained by hardwiring $y$ also has distinct input vertices, and each of its NOT gates has exactly one input.
hypotheses_covered: $y$ assigns Boolean values to the last $m$ inputs

Each NOT gate of $C$ has exactly one input
